versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

Initial release of google-super: Unified access to Google services via managed OAuth.

- Integrates Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Tasks, Photos, Maps, Analytics, and Ads in one connection.
- Provides 400+ tools for reading, writing, searching, sharing, and managing Google resources.
- Enables sending emails, managing events, editing documents/spreadsheets, searching files, and querying analytics from chat.
- Uses ClawLink for secure OAuth and connection management.
- Includes short setup instructions and a detailed reference for major tool categories.
